operator.localApplicationDomain: 0<q<qStar, where the listed original source fields are defined.
operator.globalDefinition: Apply (10.4) on the original local domain and extend it identically by zero outside. The entire cutoff support lies in q<qStar/2, so the two definitions agree on an open overlap.
operator.divergenceIdentity: div curl(c*A)=0 and div(c*B_e_theta)=r^-1 partial_theta(c*B)=0, using the same original axisymmetric B and theta-independent cutoff.
operator.zeroBranchProof: Inside the original local domain, c=0 and all spatial cutoff derivatives vanish, so every operator coefficient is zero. Outside that domain the global definition is identically zero; no undefined local field is evaluated or multiplied by zero.
operator.plateauProof: c=1 and grad(c)=0 give the original curl(A)+B_e_theta and the same p_loc, with no omitted commutator.

coreIdentity.localField: u_loc equals the original realized M2 background on the open core
coreIdentity.localizedField: On the executed unit cutoff plateau, u=curl(cA)+cB equals that same background, including every velocity component.

lastResolvedTau.meaning: Smallest positive source-expression tau among the archived inner-path enclosures. The separate executed support proof identifies these components with the original localized core restriction. This finite archived observation set does not limit the smaller positive tau in the analytic growth proof.

tangentialAxialBound.statement: All requested normalized E/U/profile radial-bracket derivatives are <=coefficient*q^(2h), for0<q<=1, once the all-order diagonal induction has been established.

physicalRadialNormalizedBound.derivation: The original q^A radial component equals q^h times the profile radial bracket/R. Leibniz adds at most(1+h)^m. The finite n=1 and n=2 terms retain their actual q^(2nh) powers.

actualFiniteBlock.tailProof: sum_(n>=J)2^-n*q^(nh)<=2^(1-J)*q^(Jh); J>=3 and0<q<=1. The finitely many n<J are evaluated with their actual B_nm, even when m>n.

completeTail.componentNormalization: Divide by eScale,j0,q^h/sqrt(Lambda), respectively; each resulting error is <=Cstar*q^(2h).
completeTail.exactErrorProof: Cstar*tau_d^(2h)=Cstar*plateau^(2h)*2^(-d)/(1+4*Cstar)<2^(-d-2). Since tau_d<plateau, every component uses the same original inner point and unit cutoff region.
